evals.prompt: Triage this incident from outage-scenario.md (in your working directory): classify the severity, capture the impact and timeline, and propose remediation. Record an incident report.
evals.expected_output: An incident artifact classified sev1 (a full checkout/payments outage for all users, no workaround), stating the impact, a timeline starting at the 14:02 detection, and proposed remediation/next steps.
assertions: The incident is classified sev1 (a full outage affecting all users, no workaround)
The impact is stated clearly (checkout/payments unavailable for all users)
A timeline is assembled (at least the 14:02 detection) and remediation/next steps are proposed
The output is a valid incident artifact (severity sev1-4, status, impact, non-empty timeline)

evals.prompt: Triage this incident from degraded-scenario.md (in your working directory) and record an incident report.
evals.expected_output: An incident artifact classified sev3 (degraded search for ~10% of users, with a working workaround — disabling the ranking_v2 flag), with the workaround captured in the remediation.
assertions: The incident is classified sev3 (degraded, not down, and a workaround exists)
The workaround (disable the ranking_v2 flag) is captured in the remediation
A valid incident artifact is produced (severity, status, impact, timeline)

component.purpose: Phase workflow: triage an incident — classify severity (sev1-4), capture impact and timeline, coordinate mitigation, and draft a postmortem — into an incident handoff. Own deterministic behavior via lib/ops.classify_incident; gated at Tier-1 and Tier-2.

should_trigger: We have an outage — start the incident response
Sev1: the service is down, coordinate the response
Triage this incident and draft a postmortem
Classify the severity of this production issue
should_not_trigger: Is the production deploy healthy right now?
Cut a release and write the changelog
Review this code for security issues
